System

Zone/local/party chat, private messages and moderation

Chat routes authenticated messages to deliberate audiences and enforces limits, blocks and moderation. Local/zone chat is not an unrestricted reliable multicast from any client; private messages and reports require identity-aware routing.

Scope and player interaction

Chat routes authenticated messages to deliberate audiences and enforces limits, blocks and moderation. Local/zone chat is not an unrestricted reliable multicast from any client; private messages and reports require identity-aware routing.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase19committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Ready → Composing → Sending → Delivered → RateLimited → Muted → Disconnected

WBP_Chat observes results from URPGChatComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_ChatPolicy_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
MessageId UUID; SenderCharacterId server-resolved; channel ID
Channel: Local|Zone|Party|Private|Guild when guilds exist
Text: bounded Unicode, normalized for control-character/abuse policy; not executable rich markup
Audience: distance/zone/party/guild/block policy resolved by authority
RateLimitState and MuteExpiryUtc: server/backend moderation state
ReportId: reporter, message reference, reason and retention policy; no public credentials

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGChatComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_ChatLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
SendChat(CommandId, Channel, RecipientId, Text) -> Accepted|RateLimited|Muted|InvalidRecipient
BlockOrReportMessage(MessageId, Reason) -> Recorded|NotFound; authenticated social service
ModerateAccount(ModeratorCapability, Action) -> Applied|Forbidden; backend/admin contract
ReceiveChat(MessageView) -> Displayed; client text-only rendering

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Client composes in WBP_Chat; entering text suspends conflicting gameplay key bindings locally but does not pause the server.
  2. Server resolves sender identity and validates channel membership, message length, rate limit, mute/block and recipient policy.
  3. Route local messages to eligible nearby clients, zone messages within the instance, party/guild messages via social membership and private messages via identity routing.
  4. Store only the moderation/audit retention selected for that channel; delivered chat is rendered as text, not evaluated HTML/commands.
  5. Reports reference message IDs and authorized moderation tools record action/reason/auditor. Blocks take effect across invites/private chat and relevant social interactions.
  6. On reconnect restore social restrictions; do not resend locally queued old messages automatically as new chat.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_ChatPolicy_Default with channel permissions, maximum length and rate limits. Add URPGChatComponent to the authenticated controller/social route.
  2. Build WBP_Chat with channel selector, history, compose, mute/report/block controls and visible send failures. Use text widgets rather than unsanitized rich markup.
  3. Configure zone/local audience resolution and backend party/private routing; no separate message-bus cluster is required for the first deployment.
  4. Create MutedAccountFixture, BlockedPairFixture and flood fixture; reopen party/guild/friends interfaces for membership checks.
  5. Define a moderation runbook, accessible reporting flow and data retention/appeal policy before public access. Exact legal obligations require separate jurisdiction review.

Reopen Phase19 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Character_A / Character_B / MutedAccountFixture. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Forged sender name/ID -> server identity replaces/rejects it.
Flood/replayed send -> bounded RateLimited/duplicate result, not server reliable queue exhaustion.
Blocked private message -> not delivered; privacy-safe sender result.
Muted account reconnects -> mute remains enforced.
Markup/control characters -> safe text/rejection, no UI injection.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed 300 Unicode characters and 5 messages per 10 seconds with burst limit 3; tune moderation/accessibility and localization needs. Do not rely on keyword filters as complete moderation.

Metrics count channel volume/rejections/reports without logging credentials. Screen-reader announcements are configurable to avoid flooding; chat text size is adjustable.
